func probe_isize(x int, y int, z int, n uint32) {
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(x, int(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMax2(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMax2(x, int(2)))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(wjMax2(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPow(x, n))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPow(x, uint32(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjAbs(x))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSignum(x))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWNeg(x))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjBool((x < 0))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjBool((x > 0))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(x, int(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(x, int(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(x, int(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(x, int(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(x, int(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatMul(x, int(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatMul(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(x, y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(x, int(3)), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedSub(x, y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedSub(x, int(3)), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedSub(wjAdd(x, z), y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(x, y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(x, int(3)), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(wjAdd(x, z), y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(x, y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(x, int(3)), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(wjAdd(x, z), y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedRem(x, y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedRem(x, int(3)), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedRem(wjAdd(x, z), y), int(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRemEuclid(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRemEuclid(x, int(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRemEuclid(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjDivEuclid(x, y))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjAbsDiff(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x >> (uint(n) % 64)))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(wjMax2(x, uint32(1)), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(wjMax2(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPow(x, n))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPow(x, uint32(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjBool((x > 0))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(x, uint32(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(x, uint32(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(x, uint32(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(x, uint32(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(x, uint32(3)))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatMul(x, uint32(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatMul(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(x, y), uint32(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(x, uint32(3)), uint32(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint32(0)))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(x, y), uint32(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(x, uint32(3)), uint32(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint32(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(x, y), uint32(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(x, uint32(3)), uint32(0)))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedRem(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint32(0)))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjAbsDiff(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x << (uint(n) % 32)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x << (uint(uint32(3)) % 32)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x >> (uint(n) % 32)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x >> (uint(uint32(3)) % 32)))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjCtz(x))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjBool((wjPopcnt(x) == 1))) + "\n")
	var s string = wjItoa(x)
	_ = s
	wjPrint(("" + s) + "\n")
}
func probe_u64(x uint64, y uint64, z uint64, n uint32) {
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(x, uint64(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMax2(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMax2(x, uint64(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(wjMax2(x, uint64(1)), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(wjMax2(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPow(x, n))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPow(x, uint32(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjBool((x > 0))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(x, uint64(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(x, uint64(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(x, uint64(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(x, uint64(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(x, uint64(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedSub(x, uint64(3)), uint64(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedSub(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint64(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(x, y), uint64(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(x, uint64(3)), uint64(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint64(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(x, y), uint64(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(x, uint64(3)), uint64(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint64(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedRem(x, y), uint64(0)))) + "\n")

	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjAbsDiff(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")

func probe_usize(x uint, y uint, z uint, n uint32) {
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(x, uint(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMax2(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMax2(x, uint(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(wjMax2(x, uint(1)), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjMin2(wjMax2(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPow(x, n))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPow(x, uint32(2)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjBool((x > 0))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWSub(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjWMul(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatSub(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatMul(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatMul(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjSatMul(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(x, y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(x, uint(3)), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedAdd(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedSub(x, y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedSub(x, uint(3)), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedSub(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(x, y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(x, uint(3)), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedMul(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(x, y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(x, uint(3)), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedDiv(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedRem(x, y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedRem(x, uint(3)), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjUnwrapOr(wjCheckedRem(wjAdd(x, z), y), uint(0)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRemEuclid(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRemEuclid(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRemEuclid(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjDivEuclid(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjDivEuclid(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjDivEuclid(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjAbsDiff(x, y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjAbsDiff(x, uint(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjAbsDiff(wjAdd(x, z), y))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x << (uint(n) % 64)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x << (uint(uint(3)) % 64)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x >> (uint(n) % 64)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa((x >> (uint(uint(3)) % 64)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRotl(x, n))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRotl(x, uint32(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRotr(x, n))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjRotr(x, uint32(3)))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjPopcnt(x))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjClz(x))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjItoa(wjCtz(x))) + "\n")
	wjPrint(("" + wjBool((wjPopcnt(x) == 1))) + "\n")
	var s string = wjItoa(x)
	_ = s
	wjPrint(("" + s) + "\n")
}
func wj_main() {
	probe_i8(int8(100), int8(7), int8(3), uint32(5))
	probe_i16(int16(100), int16(7), int16(3), uint32(5))
	probe_i32(int32(100), int32(7), int32(3), uint32(5))
	probe_i64(int64(100), int64(7), int64(3), uint32(5))
	probe_isize(int(100), int(7), int(3), uint32(5))
	probe_u8(uint8(100), uint8(7), uint8(3), uint32(5))
	probe_u16(uint16(100), uint16(7), uint16(3), uint32(5))
	probe_u32(uint32(100), uint32(7), uint32(3), uint32(5))
	probe_u64(uint64(100), uint64(7), uint64(3), uint32(5))
	probe_usize(uint(100), uint(7), uint(3), uint32(5))
}
func main() { wjRun(wj_main) }
